newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Bangladeshis in Kuwait send home $208 mln in '96.
newsitem.headline: Bangladeshis in Kuwait send home $208 mln in '96.

text.p: Bangladeshi workers in Kuwait sent home $208 million in 1996 compared with just $35 million in 1991, Bangladeshi State Minister for Labour and Manpower M.A. Mannan was quoted on Monday as saying.
"Our 140,000 expatriates here in Kuwait have sent back home in 1996 an amount of $208 million in terms of remittances," he told Kuwait Times.
Some two million Bangladeshis sent home over $1.2 billion in 1995, some 41 percent of the country's annual total foreign exchange incomes, Mannan earlier told Reuters in Dhaka.
Mannan, who is on a four-day visit to the oil-rich Gulf Arab state, told Kuwait Times he was seeking an increase in the recruitment of skilled Bangladeshi labours by Kuwait.

He also expressed appreciation for the Kuwaiti government's intention to fix a minimum monthly wage for labourers of 50 dinars ($164). Many unskilled Asian workers in Kuwait earn some 35 dinars a month as house servants or office messengers.
